hinweis: Please clean with attention to detail — it should feel properly cleaned, nothing skipped or overlooked. Everything has its fixed place: put things back exactly where they belong. If you are unsure about anything (for example the coffee machine), please just ask! If the laundry gets too much in some weeks, tell us. And when you leave, please check that the hallway in front of the apartment looks tidy too.

everyVisit.text: Kitchen: clean all surfaces and leave everything tidy
Dishwasher: run it and put everything away — it must be empty at the end
Fridge: check for spoiled food and take it out
Clean the coffee machine (ask us if you're not sure how)
Dust the fronts and handles of cupboards and furniture
Put everything back in its proper place — neat and precise, even if we left it somewhere else
Bedroom dressers: clear off what doesn't belong and wipe them with a clean cloth
Bathrooms: clean the taps until they shine (no streaks) and the toilets inside and out
Bathrooms: arrange the bottles and everything on the counters neatly, clean the toothbrush holders and cups on the outside
Laundry: wash as much as possible, fold and put away neatly — steam wrinkled clothes before they go into the wardrobe
Kitchen shelf with the mail: sort the letters and arrange everything neatly
Floors in the main areas: vacuum (or start the robot vacuum) and mop the kitchen, dining area and entryway — no stains
Bathroom floors: mop thoroughly with proper cleaning product

weekly.text: Put fresh sheets on the beds (unless we ask for it more often)
Deep-clean the shower, including thorough limescale removal
Fridge: wipe out and clean the inside
Floors very thoroughly: vacuum and mop the whole apartment, including all corners (also in the dressing room next to the vanity table) — no stains anywhere

biweekly.text: Shower drain: take out the grate and clean it
Kitchen cupboards: open one, wipe it out and arrange it neatly (a different one each time)
Windows: quick clean with the special window cloth (a thorough clean every 2 months)

oneTime.text: Clean the whirlpool on the terrace and put the cover on
Terrace: have a look outside and arrange everything neatly so it doesn't look wild
Bedroom wardrobe: sort it properly — ask us how we'd like it organized
